continuity.arc_goal: Implement linked workflows MVP — parent-to-child workflow links with completion blocking, cross-partition cancellation, and observable state graphs. Success = end-to-end integration test passes with full create/complete/cancel/remove flow.

progress_update.summary: We completed the linked workflows MVP runtime implementation. All 3 phases implemented, 2 code reviews done with all findings fixed, tests consolidated from 8 to 6 with same coverage. 8 commits on linked-workflows branch. Feature is complete for the server side — SDK integration and deferred items remain.
progress_update.goal: Implement linked workflows MVP with cross-partition support. Success = parent workflow starts linked child, child blocks parent completion, cancellation propagates through link tree, RemoveLink orphans child, end-to-end integration test passes.
accomplished: Completed plan review (session start) — agreed on 8 simplifications, rewrote plan with vertical slices
Executed all 3 implementation waves: link table+CreateLink, Completing+LinkCompletionNotification, RemoveLink+cancel propagation
Code review after Phase 2: fixed workflow-only Completing guard, removed label field (key by child_service_id), added O(1) lookup
Code review after Phase 3: fixed 3 bugs — cancel from Invoked propagates to children, kill on Completing bypasses link barrier, link check moved outside sinks/retention guard
Consolidated tests from 8 to 6 with extracted helpers, maintaining full coverage
progress_update.now: Feature complete. Final handoff. All tests passing, all review findings addressed.
next_steps: SDK implementation: CreateLink/RemoveLink codec in service-protocol-v4 (currently unimplemented!() stubs)
Deferred: HandlerInvocation sink / onCompleted for virtual objects
Deferred: Graph traversal API, orphan GC, SSE streaming for linked graphs
Consider squashing commits before merge to main
constraints: Cross-partition links from day one — all link operations use outbox messages
Only workflows can enter Completing — VOs complete immediately regardless of links
Links keyed by (parent_service_id, child_service_id) — no label, no child_invocation_id
RemoveLinkCommand cannot trigger Completing→Completed via journal entry (journal entries only dispatched for Invoked/Suspended/Paused)
decisions: Removed label field entirely — links identified by child_service_id, not arbitrary label string
Extracted cancel_linked_children helper used by cancel (Invoked/Suspended/Paused + Completing) and kill (Completing)
Link barrier check moved outside sinks/retention guard — workflows always enter Completing with running links
No active_children_count — query link table for Running links instead of maintaining denormalized counter
Completion delivers Result<T, E> only — no status field, no inline frozen graph
Completing variant carries InFlightInvocationMetadata + buffered ResponseResult
RemoveLink included in MVP — graph curation is load-bearing
End-to-end integration test included in MVP scope
Cancellation is local per node — each node cancels its own direct children
Defer HandlerInvocation sink / onCompleted to post-MVP
open_questions: Graph traversal API — how does a parent inspect the frozen state graph of completed children? (deferred)
Orphan GC policy — default timeout for orphaned workflows? (deferred)
risks: Service protocol v4 codec for CreateLink/RemoveLink has unimplemented!() stubs — will panic if SDK sends before codec is implemented
